_README: F-131: the one status vocabulary. Every surface that names the reading or the connection state takes its words from this table: the dashboard bar (web/status.js barStatus, readingView, linkView), the overlay status slot (app/shared/render_gate.js), the Checks rows (server/al/diag.py through server/al/statuswords.py) and the strip's next step (web/status.js zoneNext). web/status.js and app/shared/render_gate.js hold a copy of this file without _README between their STATUS_WORDS marker lines; tests/test_status_words.py and app/test/statuswords.test.js fail when a copy differs. kit and glyph are the kit state vocabulary (ops/fleet_kit/tokens.json). rank: the bar shows the worse (higher) of the reading and the feed state; a tie goes to the reading state. overlay: at most overlay_beside_max characters beside the level text, or overlay_alone_max when overlay_alone (the HUD then shows no numbers). check_row: the Checks row that names the state; check: its detail. next: the player's one next act, empty when there is none. fault: the Checks row is a fix row (fix = next); a pending choice or a quiet log is never a fault. null: that surface never names the state. idle comes only from Client.txt staleness (decision 0029).

off.check: Not given yet. Allow it on the Play tab.
off.next: Press "Allow reading Client.txt" on the Play tab.

idle.bar: log quiet, still reading - game closed or AFK?
idle.check: The game may be closed, or you are AFK.

missing.bar: Client.txt not found - start the game once
missing.next: Start Path of Exile 2 once so it writes Client.txt. AshLight finds it by itself.

unreadable.check: Client.txt is there but can't be read. AshLight keeps trying.
unreadable.next: Close any program that has Client.txt open, or check that you can open the file yourself.

path_missing.check: The Client.txt path in your settings is missing.
path_missing.next: Correct "client_log" in config\local.json, or remove it so AshLight finds Client.txt by itself. Starting the game once may also create it.

stalled.next: Run scripts\run.ps1 to start AshLight's parts again.

link_down.next: Start AshLight again from its Start Menu shortcut.

link_token.bar: open AshLight from the link it showed at start
link_token.next: Use the AshLight window, or open the link AshLight showed at start.
